name: tidepool
description: SaucerSwap V2 liquidity vault: an HTS share token over a concentrated-liquidity position that compounds fees and re-centres on the pool TWAP.

steps.text: Tidepool manages a live SaucerSwap V2 position, so it runs against Hedera testnet, not a local chain. The frontend already points at the published testnet vault.

steps.label: Generate or import a deployer account
Deposit, open the position, and print HashScan links

steps.text: Use the separate narrow test vault (hardhat:deploy:narrow, hardhat:deposit, hardhat:move-price, hardhat:rebalance). It moves the shared testnet pool price; read the README section 'Optional: narrow-vault rebalance demo' first.
